name: fix(dws): align group and direct chat access controls
summary: Merged pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code: DWS group and direct-message access now obey the group and DM policy controls.
description: Merged pull request (#11836) in QwenLM/qwen-code: DWS group and direct-message access now obey the existing groupPolicy and dmPolicy controls across subscriptions, history polling, late callbacks and pending replay, and the managed editor exposes direct-message access separately from sender authorization with the Open default for configurations that omit it.
